citizen.name: Mara Kettle
citizen.learned: Grew up in a fishing village up the coast and learned to mend nets, sails and rope before she could read a chart; she reads the sea the way other people read a newspaper.
citizen.lifestyle: Up before dawn, works by the pier or on the beach, asleep early unless the tide keeps her up.
citizen.currently: Looking for a dry place to work and a kettle of tea; she heard Vesper has a lighthouse that answers lights at sea.

relationships: Emmet knew her father; she remembers him from the harbour when she was a girl.
Showed Juno how to splice rope on the pier; Juno listened longer than usual.
Asked Ines about the answering light; Ines said nothing, but Mara noticed her hands still.

text: Mara Kettle arrived on the morning cart with a roll of tarred twine and a question about the light that answered the lighthouse two nights ago.
